nodes.label: Fix four payment bugs before enabling live YooKassa
Set FRONTEND_URL to pulse.inside-trade.ru for correct return_url
Manual refund and subscription deactivation on chargeback
Use build-time env because Capacitor WebView origin is not production domain
VITE_ prefix required for client bundle exposure
Replace Telegram-only with universal native share to support any app
Auth modal trigger for anonymous users
Public endpoint drives engagement without login
In-memory cache reduces DB load from 1000/min to one per 5min
Reuse existing admin SQL to avoid schema changes
Anonymous users must log in to subscribe
Remove token before dispatch so handleLogout sees no token
Use 'true' string per YooKassa API docs
Daily 09:00 UTC run renewals for users expiring within 3 days
payment.succeeded webhook confirms auto-renew; canceled marks failed
Render Static Site ignores render.yaml in public directory
offsetLeft/offsetTop give position relative to positioned card
getBoundingClientRect returns viewport coordinates causing offset drift
JS redirect prevents indexing; serve real HTML content
Canonical points to /news/:slug to avoid duplicate content
Sitemap limited to 5000 recent URLs per Google limit
Server sends refresh not news, so chime must play on refresh
AudioContext on iOS requires user gesture to resume
Log debounce intervals to debug suppressed sounds
Liquid glass visual feedback improves mute toggle UX
Inline SVG needed because lucide path cannot be styled
Reduce button to 38x38 to be ~86% of primary CTA
Sound toggle only relevant for logged-in users
Move SSE from Home to App so notifications work on all pages
UnreadCountContext avoids prop drilling for badge reset
Move counter below cloud to free width on mobile
Remove duplicate Framer layout to fix flex-wrap
window.opener is null after cross-origin redirect
BroadcastChannel uses origin for same-origin communication
Keep window.opener fallback for older browsers
Official widget guarantees delivery compared to t.me start parameter
Verify HMAC-SHA256 and auth_date to prevent replay attacks
Keep deep link fallback for ad blockers and user preference
Telegram OAuth iframe sends direct object; handle both wrapped and direct formats
Popup must parse hash before React router mounts
Popup sends auth data to parent via postMessage
Official library replaces unstable internal window.open endpoint
BotFather Allowed URLs required for OAuth client
Use popup.location.hash polling for window.open popup
embed=1 is intended for iframe, not popup
Handle my_chat_member to deactivate channel immediately on block
Catch 403 on sendMessage to deactivate if webhook missed
Poll only on notifications tab to balance UX and load
5-second interval gives quick feedback without excessive requests
